sources.title: Virtual homology of limit groups and profinite rigidity of direct products
sources.verification: Theorem A/3.5 restricted classification; Theorem 2.16 virtual retractions; Theorem 3.2 restates Arzhantseva; §5.2 examples. Primary source for its own classification.

sources.title: Virtually Free-by-Cyclic Groups
sources.verification: Introduction and Theorem 1.1, including explicit convention that the free kernel need not be finitely generated; Theorem 6.1 states Fisher fibering criterion.

sources.authors: Sam P. Fisher and Pablo Sánchez-Peralta; appendix Marco Linton
sources.title: Coherent RFRS groups
sources.verification: Theorem 1.2, Corollary 1.6 and discussion explicitly preserve infinitely generated free kernels; checked as a recent update, not a solution to 21.139.

sources.title: Improved algebraic fibrings
sources.verification: Downloaded primary source. Abstract verified via arXiv entry; exact fibering hypothesis also checked in KL Theorem 6.1. Requires all L2-Betti numbers through n to vanish.

sources.title: Approximating L2-invariants by their finite-dimensional analogues
sources.verification: Abstract/introduction verify normalized rational Betti approximation for a finite CW complex and normal residual chain.

sources.title: L2-Betti numbers of mapping tori and groups
sources.verification: Theorem 2.1, preprint printed pp.6–7: L2-Betti vanishing for mapping tori with finite skeleta. Also gives the elementary degree/index proof.

sources.title: On Quasiconvex Subgroups of Word Hyperbolic Groups
sources.verification: Theorem 1 on printed p.191: infinite-index quasiconvex H in non-elementary torsion-free hyperbolic G extends to quasiconvex H*Z.

sources.authors: Frédéric Haglund and Daniel T. Wise
sources.title: Special Cube Complexes
sources.version: Author corrected preprint dated 16 July 2007; journal 2008
sources.verification: Theorem 1.1 embedding; Corollary 6.7; Theorem 7.3 proof, preprint printed pp.24–25, explicitly produces finite-index retraction onto a quasiconvex subgroup.

sources.authors: Frédéric Haglund and Daniel T. Wise
sources.title: A combination theorem for special cube complexes
sources.verification: Primary journal abstract confirms simplest-type uniform arithmetic hyperbolic manifolds are cubical and virtually special; background high-dimensional control only.

sources.title: Author research page
sources.verification: Primary author page used to find the recent coherence preprint; not used as substitute for theorem text.

ancillary_audit_source.title: Divisible cube complexes and finite-order automorphisms of RAAGs
ancillary_audit_source.verification: Independent audit reported v2 Theorem A and Corollary B(a) for ancillary compact-special surface assertion; not downloaded or relied on for main virtual-special argument.
